cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. Just nod and I'll accept the sofa delivery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will it fit through the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. We can measure after securing the bargain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then nod before they start measuring too.
